Company accounts filing software compared by price

Tools that file micro-entity or small company accounts, with each price read on the vendor's own page

This table lists tools that file micro-entity or small company accounts at Companies House. A tool is in the table when it is on the Companies House list of software for filing company accounts, shows a public price on its own website, and does the same job. We read each price on the vendor's own website on 13 November 2026. The table is a selection of 5 tools, not every tool on the list.

The list is Find software for filing company accounts.

The rows run from the lowest price for one year to the highest: a monthly price counts 12 times.

Tool What it files Price, in the vendor's words Source
DaFinIT-Micro Micro-entity accounts, with the Company Tax Return From £2.50 per filing Price read on 13 November 2026: the price page
DIY Accounting Submit (our own product) Micro-entity, small and dormant company accounts £9.99 a year Our price list
Tax Optimiser Company accounts, with the Company Tax Return CT600 + accounts from £10 + VAT Price read on 13 November 2026: the price page
Simple CompanyTax Micro-entity accounts, with the Company Tax Return £25 +VAT per year for eligible active micro-entity companies using FRS 105 Price read on 13 November 2026: the price page
TinyTax Micro-entity and small company accounts, with the Company Tax Return Solo £69 per year Price read on 13 November 2026: the price page
Easy Digital Filing Micro-entity accounts, with the Company Tax Return Micro Companies £119 +VAT Price read on 13 November 2026: the price page

DIY Accounting Submit is on this page for comparison and is not on the Companies House list. Several tools also file the Company Tax Return, and their price covers both.

Prices change. The vendor's own page is the authority, so check it before you buy.
